title: BagelVulture's First Mod
description: a bunch of random additions that aren't quite vanilla+
body:
This is BagelVulture's first Minecraft mod.


BagelVulture is new to Minecraft modding, so this experimental mod includes many things like:

- bevultrium ore set
- diseased wood set
- tardigrades
- spears
- chairs
- ancient altars
- paintings, effects, enchantments, and so much more!


There is EMI, JEI, and REI compatability.


This mod is not meant to be balanced or vanilla freindly and it will not be getting any official updates or ports.
